items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: so you could say to the baritone player, to Johnakins, 'Okay, Johnakins, you got it', and then he used to make a poetry out of it

ctx.x: Your entire band was there, with Graciela, did you have any featured artists?

Well, my band, our band, they were so versatile because, not just best style because is a lot of people that had ideas and they put it together, whatever, no, no, no, no, they knew what they was doing. They were professional, so from out of two chords, one chord, they used to make thirty-two bars ideas, everyone; so you could say to the baritone player, to Johnakins, 'Okay, Johnakins, you got it', and then he used to make a poetry out of it; and Gene Johnson and Skerritt and Bobby Woodlen, and the piano players…
What kind of billing did you get for that? Do you remember what kind of billing you got?
